Overview:

Conectando clientes aos mercados – e talentos às oportunidades

Com 4.300 funcionários e mais de clientes de varejo e institucionais em mais de 80 escritórios espalhados pelos cinco continentes, somos um fornecedor listado na Fortune 100 e listado na Nasdaq, conectando clientes aos mercados globais – com foco em inovação, conexão humana e fornecendo soluções mundiais produtos e serviços de primeira classe para todos os tipos de investidores.

Estamos buscando por um Analista de Back Office para integrar a StoneX Comercializadora de Energia, nossa subsidiária recém-criada focada na comercialização física de energia elétrica no Brasil. Essa posição dará suporte às rotinas operacionais específicas do mercado brasileiro de energia elétrica, garantindo conformidade com os requisitos regulatórios e execução eficiente dos processos. A função é crítica para o sucesso da nossa nova linha de negócios e atuará em estreita colaboração com diversos departamentos da StoneX Consultoria.

Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.

With 4,500+ employees and over 300,000 commercial, institutional, payments, and retail clients, we operate from more than 70 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.

We are seeking a Back Office Analyst to join StoneX Energy Trading Company, our newly established subsidiary focused on physical electricity trading in Brazil. This role will support operational routines specific to the Brazilian electricity market, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and efficient execution of processes. The position is critical to the success of our new business line and will work closely with multiple departments within StoneX Consultoria.

Responsibilities:

  • Garantir a execução precisa e pontual das atividades de back-office relacionadas à comercialização física de energia elétrica, em conformidade com as regulamentações do mercado e políticas internas.
  • Processar e validar transações de comercialização de energia elétrica de acordo com as regras da CCEE (Câmara de Comercialização de Energia Elétrica).
  • Gerenciar atividades de liquidação, reconciliação e elaboração de relatórios para contratos de energia física.
  • Manter registros e documentação precisos para garantir conformidade regulatória.
  • Interagir com equipes internas (Operações, Risco, Financeiro) e partes externas para resolver discrepâncias.
  • Dar suporte a auditorias e inspeções regulatórias conforme necessário.
  • Contribuir para melhorias de processos e aprimoramentos de sistemas visando eficiência operacional.

Ensure accurate and timely execution of back-office activities related to physical electricity trading, in compliance with market regulations and internal policies.

Process and validate electricity trading transactions in accordance with CCEE (Câmara de Comercialização de Energia Elétrica) rules.

  • Manage settlement, reconciliation, and reporting activities for physical energy contracts.
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation for regulatory compliance.
  • Liaise with internal teams (Operations, Risk, Finance) and external stakeholders to resolve discrepancies.
  • Support audits and regulatory inspections as needed.
  • Contribute to process improvements and system enhancements for operational efficiency.

  • Experiência em operações de back-office, liquidação ou reconciliação financeira.

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
About the job Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data-driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media .

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • User Research – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user-friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms.
  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

description:
Company Overview

BotCity is building the future of automation with the Governance Platform for Python automations and AI Agents. We empower enterprises to innovate at scale, bringing governance, control, and observability to every automation project. Our philosophy is simple: automation is software, and software deserves the same high‑code standards that drive innovation in AI and machine learning. We recently raised a $12M Series A, led by Four Rivers with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and top industry leaders such as Lew Cirne (New Relic), Rod Johnson (Spring Source), and Walter Kortschak. With 1,000+ customers in 70+ countries, including Bayer and LG, and recognition by G2 (2024) as one of the world’s top 25 emerging platforms, BotCity is scaling fast. We’re a global remote company with teams across the US and LATAM, united by a shared vision to redefine how enterprises build and manage automation.

Role Overview

The ITOps Analyst will handle all IT operational needs at BotCity (excluding product, engineering, and InfoSec), covering tasks from user provisioning to device management to infrastructure support. This role is crucial to ensuring that internal teams (sales, ops, marketing, etc.) can operate without IT friction or downtime. The ideal person is a hands‑on problem‑solver with strong ownership, technical versatility, and clear communication.

Responsibilities

  • Manage user lifecycle, including provisioning, de‑provisioning, access controls, and permissions across systems (G Suite, Office 365, Slack, internal tools).
  • Oversee hardware and software asset inventory, including acquisitions, deployments, refresh cycles, and warranties.
  • Set up, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot workstations, peripherals, mobile devices, VPNs, and basic network connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve user IT tickets (desktop, laptop, OS, connectivity, software) promptly.
  • Coordinate with vendors for support, maintenance, and procurement (SaaS tools, licensing).
  • Create, maintain and enforce internal IT policies and standards (passwords, device encryption, backup, patching).
  • Support onboarding and off‑boarding processes with IT compliance (access removal, exit checklist).
  • Monitor and manage internal systems (file shares, backup, printers, internal tools) and alert on issues.
  • Create and maintain documentation of IT processes, configurations, user guides, and policies.
  • Assist with small infrastructure projects (office moves, network upgrades, software rollouts).
  • Escalate and coordinate with Engineering and Security teams when needed (e.g., deeper system issues).

Requisitos

  • Technical diploma in Information Systems, Systems Analysis or related degree.
  • Experience (3+ years) in an IT support, systems, or operations role (generalist).
  • Strong experience with user and access management systems (e.g., Google Workspace, SSO, IAM).
  • Experience with service management frameworks / ticketing systems (e.g., Zendesk, ServiceNow).
  • Hands‑on experience with Windows / macOS workstations and standard corporate software stacks.
  • Basic knowledge of network fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, TCP/IP) and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with device management (MDM), patching, endpoint security.
  • Experience with inventory / asset management systems.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to work autonomously.
  • Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience working with MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion, Slack.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support events and meet the team.
  • Portuguese – Fluent.
  • English – Advanced.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to basic scripting / automation (Shell, Python, PowerShell) to automate repetitive IT tasks.
  • Exposure to security best practices (patch management, endpoint protection).
  • Prior experience in an early‑stage, high‑growth, and fast‑paced startup environment or technology companies.

Employment Details

  • Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level
  • Employment type: Full‑time
  • Job function: Information Technology
  • Industries: Human Resources Services

A Ekballo IT está em fase de expansão com a implantação de um SOC (Security Operations Center) especializado em atender ambientes críticos e altamente regulados, com foco em empresas do setor elétrico , especialmente em projetos de transmissão de energia e subestações .

Nosso compromisso é garantir total aderência aos requisitos técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios exigidos pelo ONS, ANEEL e pelas boas práticas do setor elétrico .

Estamos buscando um(a) Especialista em Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) e SOAR , com experiência comprovada, para atuar em operações de missão crítica, garantindo segurança, rastreabilidade e conformidade de ponta a ponta.

Responsabilidades:
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento, operação e evolução do SOC da Ekballo IT, com foco em ambientes críticos do setor elétrico;
  • Desenvolver, testar e operar playbooks de automação (SOAR) e processos robustos de Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) , alinhados aos padrões técnicos e regulatórios;
  • Assegurar a aderência total aos requisitos estabelecidos pelo ONS, ANEEL e às boas práticas aplicáveis ao segmento de transmissão de energia e subestações ;
  • Produzir documentação técnica rastreável, auditável e aderente aos processos regulatórios e operacionais;
  • Participar ativamente do processo de mobilização técnica , respeitando os cronogramas acordados com o cliente, garantindo a entrega de todos os artefatos técnicos exigidos.
Atividades Técnicas: Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI):
  • Coletar, processar e enriquecer informações de ameaças (OSINT, FortiGuard, ISACs e outros feeds);
  • Correlacionar IOCs com eventos detectados no FortiSIEM, FortiEDR e ferramentas do ecossistema Fortinet;
  • Mapear TTPs com base nos frameworks MITRE ATT&CK, Diamond Model e Kill Chain ;
  • Produzir relatórios técnicos e executivos que suportem análises de riscos cibernéticos voltadas ao setor elétrico;
  • Alimentar o FortiSOAR com dados estruturados (STIX, TAXII, CSV, JSON) para automação de respostas;
  • Atuar em threat hunting , priorizando riscos e ameaças relacionadas a ambientes OT e sistemas críticos.
️ Automação e Orquestração (SOAR):
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter playbooks no FortiSOAR , garantindo aderência técnica e regulatória;
  • Realizar integrações do FortiSOAR com FortiSIEM, FortiEDR, FortiMail, FortiWeb, FortiGate, além de sistemas de gestão como ServiceNow e GLPI;
  • Implementar automações que reduzam o tempo de resposta, otimizem o MTTR e fortaleçam a eficiência do SOC;
  • Realizar troubleshooting, ajustes e melhorias nas automações, utilizando APIs, Python, Bash ou PowerShell.
Compromissos Contratuais e Regulatórios:
  • A equipe alocada será composta por profissionais com experiência comprovada no setor elétrico , especialmente em projetos de transmissão de energia e subestações ;

  • Todos os profissionais serão previamente validados para atuação em ambientes regulados , garantindo aderência total às exigências do ONS, ANEEL e às boas práticas do setor ;
  • A Ekballo IT assegura rastreabilidade técnica e regulatória de toda a equipe e dos processos, garantindo uma operação completamente auditável e aderente aos padrões exigidos.
Requisitos Técnicos:
  • Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento e operação de playbooks no FortiSOAR ;
  • Domínio das ferramentas Fortinet: FortiSOAR, FortiSIEM, FortiEDR, FortiAnalyzer, FortiGate, FortiMail, FortiWeb ;
  • Conhecimento sólido em Threat Intelligence, IOC Enrichment, STIX/TAXII, MITRE ATT&CK, YARA ;
  • Experiência anterior em ambientes de missão crítica, preferencialmente no setor elétrico (diferencial altamente valorizado);
  • Habilidade em automação de processos, integrações via API e desenvolvimento de scripts (Python, Bash, PowerShell);

  • Certificações Obrigatórias:
  • Fortinet NSE 4 – FortiGate Security
  • Fortinet NSE 5 – FortiSIEM / FortiSOAR
  • Certificações Desejáveis:
  • NSE 6 – FortiSOAR, FortiEDR, FortiAnalyzer
  • NSE 7 – Advanced Threat Protection

description:
Somos especialistas em transformação tecnológica , unindo expertise humana à IA para criar soluções tech escaláveis. Com mais de 7 .400 CI&Ters ao redor do mundo, já formamos parcerias com mais de 1.000 clientes durante nossos 30 anos de história. Inteligência Artificial é nossa realidade.

Importante : se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente.

Descrição da Vaga

Espera-se que você seja capaz de mergulhar em conjuntos de dados complexos, provenientes de diversas fontes, e transformá-los em informações claras e acionáveis que nortearão as decisões estratégicas dos nossos clientes.

Buscamos um perfil que combine excelência técnica com uma forte visão de negócios, capaz de não apenas manipular e analisar dados, mas também de comunicar os resultados de forma eficaz para diferentes públicos, incluindo lideranças executivas.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Análise de Dados: Coletar, processar e analisar grandes volumes de dados de fontes variadas (estruturadas e não estruturadas) para identificar tendências, padrões e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Geração de Insights: Desenvolver análises aprofundadas e modelos que gerem insights estratégicos para os negócios dos clientes.
  • Comunicação Executiva: Criar e apresentar relatórios, dashboards e visualizações de dados de forma clara, concisa e impactante para stakeholders e executivos.
  • Autonomia e Proatividade: Trabalhar de forma independente na gestão de projetos de análise de dados, desde a concepção e planejamento até a entrega dos resultados.
  • Colaboração: Atuar em colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares, incluindo engenheiros de dados, cientistas de dados e especialistas de negócio, para garantir a entrega de soluções de alto valor.
  • Mentoria: Contribuir para o desenvolvimento técnico de outros membros da equipe, compartilhando conhecimentos e melhores práticas.

Qualificações e Requisitos

  • Experiência Comprovada: Sólida experiência profissional como Analista de Dados ou em posições similares.

description:
Critical Environment Field Service Engineer (CEFSE)

Join to apply for the Critical Environment Field Service Engineer (CEFSE) role at Microsoft Power Platform Community

Business Function Overview

In alignment with Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day. As a CO+I CE Field Service Engineer, you will deliver core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform.

Responsibilities

  • Ensures compliance with data center business units and service-level policies.
  • Engages with appropriate teams and resources to execute tasks or projects.
  • Manages programs associated with area of responsibility.
  • Demonstrates conscientiousness on cost adheres to budget requirements; keeps costs reasonable and contributes to staying within budget.
  • Follows and adheres to safety and security policies and procedures. Reports immediately any safety or security issues or concerns.
  • Participates in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) process as appropriate.
  • Maximize Critical Environment (CE) availability in conjunction with our landlord partners at our leased Datacenters and to ensure optimal operational efficiency.
  • Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in our leased Datacenters.
  • Reduce high-impact and human-error Critical Environment (CE) incidents year over year.
  • Deliver on cost/energy efficiency initiatives.
  • Support delivery of the Datacenter’s Emergency Preparedness and Response plans and act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within our leased datacenters.
  • Coordinate, plan, schedule, and supervise CE audits and compliance verification as needed.
  • Ensure routine reporting to effectively manage and analyze our Power/Temperature/Relative Humidity, and SLA monitoring.
  • Establish and enhance strong working relationships and engagement with our Engineering Groups (EGs), and Landlord partners (including contributing to MBRs, QBRs).
  • Work with regional and global peers to share and build best practices across the entire datacenter portfolio.
  • Hold self-accountable for the end-to-end service quality, completeness, and resulting customer experience (including but not limited to availability, safety, security, customer service).
  • Supports escalation of issues to appropriate owner.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent AND 2+ year(s) industry experience in a datacenter or other critical environment facility.
  • OR 3+ years industry experience and college course work.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years’ experience in Critical Environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU).
  • Bachelor’s Degree or Technical College certification in mechanical or electrical engineering and/or services.
  • Experience working on large scale CE projects.
  • Experience with the operation of IT infrastructure (Servers, SANs, Networking, etc.).

Background Check Requirements

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Equal Opportunity

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request via the Accommodation request form.

Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Microsoft and the country where you work.

title: Product Manager - Seller Tools
description:
Please note that this role works 100% on‑site.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on‑demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and tabletop beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

As a Product Manager for Seller Tools, you will drive the evolution of our ecosystem of tools, ensuring it is both user‑centric and technically sound. You’ll blend strong product expertise (discovery, prioritization, roadmap, UX focus) with technical depth (services, APIs, architecture, data) to deliver scalable, high‑performing solutions.

You’ll act as the connector between commercial operations, end‑users, and engineering, shaping tools that improve partner autonomy, streamline workflows, optimize execution, and unlock new opportunities through data and AI.

What you’ll do:

  • Ownership of end to end Seller Tools, from discovery to execution to adoption;
  • Lead discovery processes to identify user pain points, market gaps, and opportunities for improving workflows;
  • Define product roadmaps that align with business objectives and technical architecture;
  • Collaborate deeply with engineering and architecture teams, understanding APIs, data flows, and service dependencies to make informed product decisions;
  • Balance short‑term feature delivery with long‑term scalability and system health;
  • Translate operational and market needs into clear, technically feasible requirements;
  • Partner with Design to ensure intuitive, operator‑friendly experiences;
  • Define success metrics for features, monitor adoption, and iterate based on data insights;
  • Leverage data to drive prioritization, experimentation, and continuous improvement;
  • Lead efforts to design, integrate, and scale AI‑driven solutions across the product ecosystem;
  • Act as the voice of the customer and operator, while ensuring alignment with system capabilities and architectural vision.

What you’ll need:

  • University degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related area (or equivalent experience);
  • Years of product management experience in enterprise tools, SaaS, or related domains;
  • Strong product expertise in discovery, prioritization, roadmap definition, and UX improvements;
  • Data‑centric mindset, with experience using analytics tools (e.g., Segment, Mixpanel, Databricks, Looker, Tableau, or similar) to drive decisions;
  • Technical knowledge of APIs, microservices, cloud‑based tools, and system integrations (able to discuss trade‑offs with engineers);
  • Experience working with both frontend and backend development teams;
  • Demonstrated experience designing or integrating AI/ML features into existing products;
  • Proficiency with product management tools such as Jira and Confluence;
  • Strong understanding of Scrum and agile workflows;
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both technical and business‑focused.

More about you:

  • You’re passionate about software development and know how to ensure its quality;
  • You’re motivated by building world‑class solutions that impact millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment that uses and stimulates a DevOps culture;
  • You’re creative when solving problems and are continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

What We Offer:

  • Performance‑based bonus*
  • Attendance bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

Na Odontoclinic, somos movidos por pessoas e por sorrisos. Somos uma empresa feita de gente que gosta de gente. Aqui, acreditamos no poder da atitude, da ação e da paixão por encantar. Com mais de 28 anos de história, construímos a maior rede de franquias odontológicas do Brasil. Somos reconhecidos como uma das melhores franquias e pela excelência em atendimento.

A Odontoclinic investe em treinamentos, programas de capacitação e iniciativas que promovem o crescimento pessoal e profissional dos nossos colaboradores. Aqui você encontra um ambiente acolhedor, diverso e cheio de oportunidades, onde é possível crescer, aprender e deixar sua marca.

description:
Na Amyris, somos pioneiros no uso de micróbios para transformar açúcares derivados de plantas em moléculas de alto desempenho em larga escala. Nossa plataforma abre acesso à química requintada e sofisticada encontrada em todos os sistemas vivos, levando a novas possibilidades de produtos, oportunidades de mercado e soluções de sustentabilidade. Com escala comprovada, estamos redefinindo o que a química renovável pode fazer.

Aqui na Amyris, somos um time de pessoas criativas e inovadoras. Nós valorizamos as relações saudáveis em diferentes perspectivas e nos empenhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, abrangendo diferentes raças, etnias, gêneros, religiões, pessoas com deficiências e comunidade LGBTQIA+.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades

  • Investigar de maneira aprofundada em literatura científica mecanismos que podem vir a gerar ganhos aos processos produtivos Amyris ou que auxiliem na resolução de problemas complexos durante o desenvolvimento dos processos, na manufatura ou nos diferentes CMOs;
  • Planejar experimentos em escala piloto e de bancada necessários para o desenvolvimento de processos de fermentação das diferentes moléculas do portfolio da companhia ou para troubleshooting de campanhas de produção para que atinjam os KPIs/qualidade planejados;
  • Utilizar softwares de análise estatística para analisar os dados de cada experimento e compará-los/gerar correlações com os dados disponíveis da manufatura ou de experimentos anteriores;
  • Preparar relatórios técnicos em língua portuguesa e inglesa compilando todas as metodologias, resultados e conclusões de cada um dos experimentos executados no PD;
  • Preparar documentos de transferência de tecnologia;
  • Preparar apresentações para os diferentes fóruns de discussão de resultados, inclusive com a matriz nos Estados Unidos;
  • Realizar treinamentos e suportes de campanhas de produção de acordo com a necessidade da empresa;
  • Preparar requisições de compras para materiais necessários ao desenvolvimento de processos. Organizar transportes de amostras e preparo de documentação necessária para análises externas.
  • Acompanhamento de auditorias de segurança, biossegurança, qualidade, processos, etc (conforme determinado pelo coordenador da área);
  • Liderar projetos estratégicos da companhia, quando houver demanda/oportunidade (PTL).
  • Treinar novos pesquisadores, engenheiros de processos ou técnicos de fermentação nos processos Amyris, nos conceitos importantes de cada projeto, para cada molécula;
  • Utilizar ferramentas avançadas de planejamento de experimentos, DOEs, DCCRs, PBs para avaliação de efeitos isolados e sinergias de variáveis de processo sob os resultados dos diferentes experimentos conduzidos no PD;
  • Ter uma visão sistêmica de processos envolvendo múltiplas áreas (Fermentação, DSP, Qualidade, Regulatórios, Segurança) estabelecendo conexões com as áreas de interface e avaliando os processos Amyris de forma ampla.

Requisitos

  • Graduação completa em: Química, Biologia, Engenharia Química, Engenharia de Alimentos, Engenharia de Bioprocessos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Conhecimento em softwares de análise estatística de dados (JMP, Minitab, Statistica);
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Office – Word/Excel/Powerpoint;
  • Experiência em redação de relatórios técnicos, transferências de tecnologia e análises de dados/análises estatísticas geradas a partir dos diferentes experimentos conduzidos na planta piloto.

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI GrowthGroup

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well-known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You’ll Do

As a Product Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving the strategy, development, and delivery of impactful products and features. You’ll act as a bridge between stakeholders, customers, and technical teams to ensure that the product vision aligns with business goals and user needs.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading cross-functional teams, providing mentorship, and ensuring successful feature delivery.

  • Acting as the voice of the customer, identifying pain points, and advocating for user‑centric solutions.
  • Collaborating with engineering, design, data science, and commercial teams to define requirements and deliver value.

  • Engaging in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, retrospectives, and reviews, to ensure iterative and incremental progress.

  • Participating in technical discussions to understand system integrations, APIs, and databases.

  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experience working with cross‑functional teams in a dynamic environment.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with a customer‑centric mindset.
  • Proficiency with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and data analytics platforms.
  • Ability to write clear and actionable requirements, business cases, and user stories.
  • Technical understanding of APIs, databases, and system integrations; SQL knowledge is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

Mindset:

  • Adaptability to shifting priorities and organizational changes.
  • Creative problem‑solving skills with a focus on process and solution improvement.
  • Passionate about delivering high‑quality solutions that impact millions of users.
  • Resilient and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Why Join Us?

  • Work with a talented, diverse team on products that make a global impact.
  • Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and mentorship.
  • Be part of a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and user‑centered design.

title: KYC Analyst
description:
About Marex

Marex Group plc is a diversified global financial services platform, providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients in the energy, commodities and financial markets. It is listed on Nasdaq Global Select Market in April 2024. With more than 35 offices in Europe, the US and APAC, it has unique access across markets with a significant share globally both on and off exchange. The depth of knowledge among its teams and divisions gives customers a clear advantage, and its technology‑led service provides access to all major exchanges, order‑flow management via screen, voice and DMA, plus award‑winning data, insights and analytics.

For more information visit

Client Onboarding Department

The Client Onboarding Department is responsible for conducting the process of identifying and verifying new customers. The team plays a key role in combating financial crime and terrorist financing.

Role Summary

To ensure that customers across business divisions are on‑boarded efficiently and in accordance with Group policies and procedures.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure that appropriate CDD / KYC and AML checks are carried out on all new customers in accordance with local regulatory requirements and Group standards and procedures.
  • Ensure that appropriate client documentation is issued to all new customers and in accordance with local regulatory and any exchange requirements.
  • Ensure that appropriate customer categorisations are carried out in accordance with local regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure daily targets set by the Onboarding Manager are met.
  • Accurately update the customer pipeline on a daily basis (Neon Onboarding).
  • Ensure that client and static data is accurately input and maintained into the Client Data Base (PeopleSoft).
  • Ensure that complete records of all customer documentation are maintained.
  • Ensure that the Front‑Office, Co‑ordination Team and Quality Control Teams are advised of case progress.
  • Issue client acceptance documentation and conduct account opening.
  • Assist on any other ad‑hoc reviews, projects or audits that the Onboarding department is required to carry out.
  • Efficiently deal with general day‑to‑day ad‑hoc queries.
  • Work closely with the Financial Crime team.
  • Keep management timely informed of issues and developments.
  • Ensure compliance with the company’s regulatory requirements.
  • Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company‑determined parameters are complied with.
  • Demonstrate the highest level of standards of integrity and conduct and reflect Company Values.
  • Always comply with Marex’s Code of Conduct.
  • Fully understand and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility.
  • Report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/or your supervisor as required.
  • Escalate risk events immediately.
  • Provide input to risk management processes, as required.

Skills And Experience

  • Experience in client onboarding, KYC and risk assessment of clients.
  • Solid understanding of client categorisation.
  • Worked in support of trading desks.
  • Analytical skills.
  • Problem‑solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment and knowledge of the risk and compliance requirements associated with this.

Competencies

  • A collaborative team player, approachable, self‑efficient and influences a positive work environment.
  • Demonstrates curiosity.
  • Resilient in a challenging, fast‑paced environment.
  • Ability to work within a fast‑paced and high‑volume environment.
  • Excels at building relationships, networking and influencing others.
  • Strategic collaborator with insight and agility, able to anticipate future challenges, ensuring operational effectiveness.

Conduct Rules

  • Act with integrity.
  • Act with due skill, care and diligence.
  • Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators.
  • Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly.
  • Observe proper standard of market conduct.
  • Act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers.

Company Values

Acting as a role model for the values of the Company:

  • Respect – Clients are at the heart of our business, with superior execution and superb client service the foundation of the firm. We respect our clients and always treat them fairly.
  • Integrity – Doing business the right way is the only way. We hold ourselves to a high ethical standard in everything we do – our clients expect this and we demand it of ourselves.
  • Collaborative – We work in teams – open and direct communication and the willingness to work hard and collaboratively are the basis for effective teamwork. Working well with others is necessary for us to succeed at what we do.
  • Developing our People – Our people are the basis of our competitive advantage. We look to “grow our own” and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking, talented people choose to build their careers.
  • Adaptable and Nimble – Our size and flexibility is an advantage. We are big enough to support our client’s various needs, and adaptable and nimble enough to respond quickly to changing conditions or requirements. A non‑bureaucratic, but well‑controlled environment fosters initiative as well as employee satisfaction.
  • Marex is fully committed to the elimination of unlawful or unfair discrimination and values the differences that a diverse workforce brings to the company.

Seniority level

  • Entry level

Employment type

  • Full‑time

Job function

  • Finance and Sales

description:
Assessoria de Investimentos: Começo de carreira | Campinas

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Na XP Inc., acreditamos que nosso time é a chave para o sucesso. Procuramos profissionais em início de carreira, apaixonados pelo mercado financeiro, que compartilhem nossos valores: foco no cliente, espírito empreendedor, mente aberta e sonho grande.

Esta é uma oportunidade única para quem deseja iniciar sua trajetória como Assessor(a) de Investimentos nas marcas XP Investimentos e Rico. Valorizamos pessoas com perfil comercial, que se destacam no relacionamento interpessoal e são movidas pela busca de resultados consistentes.
Aqui, você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de comunicação, aprofundamento nos produtos de financeiros e principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira.

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina para contato online com clientes;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades;
  • Morar na cidade de Campinas, pois se trata de uma posição no modelo 100% presencial
  • Graduação superior cursando (a partir do 5º semestre) ou completa;
  • Se ainda estiver na faculdade, é necessário estar em um curso noturno;
  • Se identificar com a nossa cultura;

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter um alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.
    *Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Dinâmica e/ou entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Dinâmica avaliando habilidades específicas necessárias para a função ou discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

  • Etapa de case: Onde você poderá demonstrar sua visão estratégica e tomada de decisão na construção de soluções para um cliente.

Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de saúde sem coparticipação (inclusive, para dependentes)
  • iFood Benefícios (VA e VR flexível)
  • Licença parental: maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Auxílio Creche

Vida Financeira

  • Assessoria de Investimentos
  • Cartão XP Visa Infinite sem anuidade
  • Crédito (consignado, home equity, CCB Imobiliário, etc.)

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.
Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

Aqui na XP Inc., valorizamos as interações pessoais e acreditamos no uso do escritório como uma ferramenta para potencializar nossas relações no trabalho.

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Os projetos de eficiência energética realizam ações em comunidades baixa renda, além de beneficiar clientes residenciais com redução da conta de energia, através do uso seguro e mais eficiente da energia elétrica. As ações ocorrem nas localizações das áreas de concessão das distribuidoras do Grupo Neoenergia.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

Será responsável pela consultoria técnica em projetos de eficiência energética, com foco em edificações públicas, comerciais, industriais e residenciais, apoiando ações de engenharia, vistorias, elaboração de relatórios e suporte técnico-operacional. Atuará também na análise de projetos, acompanhamento de indicadores e cumprimento das normas técnicas e de segurança.

Gerir a logística de equipamentos (recebimento, armazenamento, descarte);
Contatar clientes das Distribuidoras;
Elaborar Diagnóstico e Projeto Básico Energético;
Elaborar Planejamento das Atividades (cronogramas e execução);
Coordenar a execução das ações de eficiência nas unidades consumidoras definidas pela CONTRATANTE;
Coordenar equipes de execução dos serviços;
Analisar estudo luminotécnicos;
Realizar treinamento sobre Eficiência Energética;
Acompanhar atividades de Medição e Verificação;
Acompanhar/ Realizar vistorias em campo para fiscalização dos serviços;
Realizar treinamento sobre Eficiência Energética
Supervisionar e coordenar o trabalho das equipes diretamente subordinadas, monitorando os indicadores e gerando relatórios;
Supervisionar e monitorar a execução dos serviços comerciais e planos de parcelamento no SAP CCS/CRM, quando necessário;
Realizar análise crítica da execução das atividades, identificar problemas e propor melhorias no processo;
Articular com as empresas parceiras para definir cronograma, recursos e alinhamento operacionais dos projetos;
Realizar contatos com representantes das unidades consumidoras para a apresentação, entrada e permanência das ações de eficiência energética;
Analisar e/ou elaborar projetos, documentos técnicos, contratos, análise de dados e afins.

title: Digital Talent | Bosch Global
description:
How Bosch is training the smartest minds

In the race to secure the best digital talent, Bosch is setting up the “Digital Talent Academy” in Brazil. It trains young people in areas such as software development and artificial intelligence. For many of them, this represents a decisive step toward a different life.

The red logotype is already recognizable from the freeway. Huge letters spelling out BOSCH adorn the main building of the Campinas location in Brazil. Nicolly Cristina Cruz Storoni had often driven past here with her mother. She had never imagined that she could ever work for the company with the red logo. But two years ago, her dream unexpectedly became reality. In July 2021, the then 17-year-old applied for a place at Bosch’s newly established Digital Talent Academy (DTA) in Campinas and prevailed over more than 2,000 candidates. She was among the top 18 who were offered a place in that year’s round of admissions.

Since summer 2021, Nicolly has been studying and working at the Digital Talent Academy at the Bosch location in Campinas, Brazil

My biggest wish is to finish my apprenticeship, buy my own apartment and car, and develop professionally in my career.

YouTube

Loading the video requires your consent. If you agree by clicking on the Play icon, the video will load and data will be transmitted to Google as well as information will be accessed and stored by Google on your device. Google may be able to link these data or information with existing data.

The Digital Talent Academy offers young talents an education with a high practical share directly at Bosch.

The DTA first opened in January 2021. The objective: to train talented young people in a variety of digital skills. These range from intelligent process automation and artificial intelligence to data analysis and software development. “We saw how great the demand is for digital skills at Bosch,” explains Johnny Palma, who first came up with the idea for a digital talent factory. “So together with Henrique Dona, who is responsible for technical training in Campinas, I devised our own training program.” The DTA collaborates with the technical school SENAI (National Industrial Apprenticeship Service) in Campinas. The large theoretical part takes place at SENAI, while the technical and practical side happens at Bosch.

This dual-education model, which has a strong tradition in countries like Germany, is unique in Brazil. Here, assuming one has the financial means to do so, the traditional options are to study or to take part in an apprenticeship program. In Brazil, however, the latter is structured more like school and offers little in the way of practical experience.

Springboard to a better life

For many young Brazilians, the DTA is a springboard to a better life. “We do not selectively filter people by education, experience, or language skills beforehand. Everybody gets the same chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means,” says Gaston Diaz Perez, the head of Bosch in Latin America. “We want to make the program accessible for all talented, ambitious young people who share our values.” In this way, Bosch not only gets the country’s top talent, but is also living up to its social responsibility. “If you give them the opportunity to develop and have a better life, we can benefit on all levels — it’s a win for our business and for society,” says Diaz Perez.

Training in software development or artificial intelligence is not only an important step for Nicolly.

applied for admission to the program this year. Thirty-six of them started as apprentices in January 2023.

Nicolly is just one of many examples that prove that what matters most here is ability. “I was surprised they accepted me,” she admits. “Who takes on a young single mother?” When she applied, her daughter was just six months old. Nicolly’s mother was skeptical about whether she would be able to handle so many responsibilities, but she still encouraged her daughter to go for it. And Nicolly was a standout — in a three-stage selection procedure consisting of an IQ test, group work, and a face-to-face interview. “At the interview stage, we find out who has the potential and the determination to develop here,” says Henrique Dona. “Most students start out not speaking a word of English or knowing how to program. Today they’re presenting their project work to members of the Bosch board of management,” he says.

When Nicolly got one of the coveted apprenticeships out of 2,000 applications, her daughter was six months old. Her goal: she wants to her daughter a good future.

Between family life and programming

Mom and digital talent for smart automation — two vocations that Nicolly masters every day anew.

Nicolly lives with her parents, her three siblings, and her two-year-old daughter in Hortolândia, a small town near Campinas. In order to juggle both family and studies, her daily routine has to be well planned. Nicolly’s day therefore starts very early. She and her daughter get up at five o’clock. Shortly after six, she catches the company shuttle that takes her to the Bosch site. The trip itself takes about an hour. When the young Brazilian steps onto the company grounds, she’s no longer a single mother. Wearing her Bosch polo shirt as a school uniform, she’s a digital talent — one of 103 in the country. Bent over her laptop, she spends her time working with different programming languages and getting to grips with robotics and her specialist area of smart automation.

“Everybody gets the chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means.”

Nicolly’s focus in the training is intelligent process automation. Together with her fellow students, she enjoys everyday campus life and togetherness.

Now in her last semester, the 19-year-old is already working on her own projects in the Electrical Drives division. “At the moment, I’m looking at things like how Excel tables can be automated so that manual input is no longer necessary,” she explains. When she finishes her apprenticeship, there’s a good chance that she’ll be offered a permanent position in the division. All the graduates in the DTA’s first cohort received a job offer from Bosch. “I want to be able to offer my daughter a good future. My biggest wish is to buy my own apartment and car,” says Nicolly, when asked about her plans for the future. The battle for the best talent will then continue into the next round. The next group of 84 digital apprentices is already waiting in the wings for their start the following semester. “When looking to recruit the best software talent, Brazil should definitely be a port of call,” says Johnny Palma. “Our apprentices will do and develop things that we haven’t even dreamed of.”

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

The Product Manager for BEES Deliver will play a pivotal role in driving the product evolution and development of our logistics digital transformation solution. This role involves leading cross-functional teams to enhance product features, optimize connectivity with the BEES ecosystem, and ensure a seamless delivery experience for our global customers. The Product Manager will be responsible for structuring the core journey of BEES Deliver to become a global product and expand its reach with minimal customizations.

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment, and adapt to changing priorities.

Qualificações

  • Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

  • Arquitetura de Sistemas: Experiência profunda com diversos padrões arquitetônicos (microsserviços, monolito modular, arquitetura orientada a eventos, serverless, SaaS, etc.) e seus trade-offs.

  • Cloud: Experiência avançada em desenho e implementação de soluções em plataformas de nuvem (principalmente Azure), incluindo IaaS, PaaS e FaaS.

  • Integração de Sistemas: Experiência com filas de mensagens (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS), APIs (REST, GraphQL), gateways de API e outros padrões de integração.
  • Segurança da Informação: Conhecimento em princípios de segurança de software (OWASP Top 10, criptografia, IAM, SSO, etc.) e design de arquiteturas seguras.
  • DevOps e CI/CD: Compreensão sólida de pipelines de CI/CD, automação, containers (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes).
  • Modelagem e Diagramação: Habilidade para utilizar ferramentas e notações de arquitetura (UML, C4 Model, Archimate) para documentar e comunicar designs.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Experiência com estratégias e ferramentas de monitoramento, logging e tracing (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Jaeger, OpenTelemetry).

description:
Analista Planejamento Financeiro Pleno (Projetos)

Nós acreditamos que a energia que você dedica à sua carreira merece retorno.

Por isso, reconhecemos a dedicação das nossas pessoas e estamos sempre em busca de quem deseja fazer a diferença e construir uma trajetória próspera e segura.

Na CPFL, você encontra um ambiente sólido para crescer com confiança, com segurança para evoluir e espaço para construir um futuro com propósito.

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial

Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade;
  • Experiência na área de Finanças;
  • Conhecimento em pacote office a partir do nível intermediário;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Desejável conhecimento em Power BI;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Campinas.

O seu dia a dia

  • Contribuir com as etapas operacionais de projetos estratégicos da Diretoria Financeira propondo soluções e controlando prazos e entregas, a fim de garantir a execução efetiva das iniciativas alinhadas às metas da área;
  • Preparar relatórios gerenciais e apresentações executivas utilizando análises comparativas e interpretação de dados financeiros, com o objetivo de subsidiar a liderança com informações relevantes para a tomada de decisão;
  • Criar e aprimorar indicadores financeiros da área com base em revisões metodológicas e acompanhamento de metas e análise crítica dos resultados, visando promover uma gestão mais eficiente e orientada a dados;
  • Realizar análises financeiras e estudos de viabilidade, utilizando modelos comparativos, premissas técnicas e mapeamento de riscos, com o propósito de propor iniciativas que otimizem o uso dos recursos financeiros da companhia;
  • Identificar e implementar melhorias operacionais a partir da análise de pontos críticos e interação com áreas parceiras, com foco em automação, padronização de processos e ganhos de eficiência;
  • Monitorar tendências do mercado financeiro por meio de estudos sobre novas tecnologias, regulamentações e modelos de negócio, com o objetivo de avaliar seu impacto estratégico e antecipar movimentos na empresa;

O que oferecemos

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 20 dias;
  • Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade);
  • Wellhub;
  • Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social).

Conheça um pouco sobre nós

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços .

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

title: Vendedor Externo - São Paulo
description:
Se você é daqueles que brilham os olhos quando o assunto é venda, busca resultado e gosta de estar abrindo portas, essa vaga é a sua cara! Estamos em busca de um Vendedor , alguém que gosta de prospectar, visitar cliente, negociar e fechar negócio de verdade. Aqui, quem faz acontecer cresce rápido, o salário fixo é só o ponto de partida.

Suas responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Prospecção ativa no B2B, com atuação em um raio de até 300 km. Esse é um trabalho para quem gosta de estrada, visita e movimento.
  • Realizar visitas comerciais, apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de equipamentos industriais (laser, TIJ, CI, TTO etc.).
  • Identificar oportunidades e desenvolver vendas transacionais para equipamentos e contratos de manutenção preventiva e corretiva.
  • Conduzir negociações de ponta a ponta, sem perder timing, ritmo ou oportunidade.
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais e registrar as oportunidades no SAP Business One.
  • Fazer gestão do funil comercial, acompanhar leads, manter follow-up ativo e garantir conversão.
  • Participar de reuniões comerciais, treinamentos e eventos técnicos.

O que buscamos no perfil:

  • Alguém hunter, disposto, persistente, que gosta de abrir clientes e não tem medo de meta.
  • Comunicação forte, postura comercial e capacidade de construir relacionamento rapidamente.
  • Capacidade de aprender sobre equipamentos industriais e apresentar soluções.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens dentro do raio de atuação.

Pré-requisitos:

  • Vivência com prospecção ativa e rotina comercial intensa.
  • CNH válida e disponibilidade para viagens regionais.
  • Organização para gerir pipeline, agenda e visitas.

Diferencial: Conhecimento em vendas de equipamentos industriais ou serviços técnicos.

Jornada de trabalho: De segunda a sexta-feira, 8h às 18h e as quintas-feiras 8h às 17h, com rotina externa predominante.

Benefícios da BETIM QUÍMICA: Assistência médica e odontológica, Auxílio combustível, Convênios (farmácia e educação), Comissionamento de 3%, Seguro de Vida, Auxílio Natalidade, Vale-Refeição Plano de Cargos e Salários, Jornada reduzida às sextas-feiras, Espaço Artes, e Day Off.

Local de trabalho: Região – São Paulo (vaga externa). Sede administrativa: Contagem – MG.

Se você é movido por resultado, gosta de desafios e quer crescer ganhando pelo que entrega, venha fazer parte da Betim Química! Estamos prontos para te conhecer.

title: CONSULTOR DE VENDAS (CAMPINAS/SP)
description:
O consultor de vendas interno de móveis é responsável por atender clientes em um ambiente de showroom, ajudando-os a encontrar soluções que atendam suas necessidades de decoração e funcionalidade. Suas principais funções incluem entender as preferências dos clientes, apresentar produtos, elaborar propostas personalizadas e negociar condições de venda. Além disso, o consultor deve acompanhar o processo de venda, gerenciar o relacionamento com os clientes e colaborar com a organização do showroom. É essencial ter conhecimento sobre as tendências do mercado de móveis, habilidades de comunicação e uma abordagem proativa para garantir a satisfação do cliente e impulsionar as vendas.

Responsabilidades

  • Identificar e prospectar novos clientes através de pesquisa de mercado, contatos diretos e outras estratégias de prospecção.
  • Realizar apresentações e demonstrações de produtos ou serviços para potenciais clientes.
  • Negociar termos e condições de venda, preparando propostas e contratos.
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos com clientes existentes, buscando oportunidades para upsell e cross-sell.
  • Acompanhar o ciclo completo de vendas, desde a geração de leads até o fechamento do contrato.
  • Analisar as necessidades dos clientes e recomendar soluções que agreguem valor e atendam às suas expectativas.
  • Monitorar e reportar as tendências do mercado e a concorrência, ajustando estratégias conforme necessário.
  • Garantir a organização do Showroom da loja e movimentar quando necessário para ambientação, tanto para mostrar ao cliente como para manter a loja ambientada.
  • Cumprir com as metas e objetivos de vendas estabelecidos pela empresa.
  • Garantir a satisfação do cliente, oferecendo suporte pós-venda e solucionando eventuais problemas.
  • Participar de treinamentos e eventos relacionados para aprimorar habilidades e conhecimentos sobre produtos e técnicas de vendas.

title: Senior Data Analyst | BEES Personalization
description:
About us


AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.


About AB InBev Growth Group


Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.


In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.


We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.


What you’ll do:



  • Design, model, and maintain end-to-end BI solutions in Power BI, including data modeling, DAX calculations, report building, and interactive dashboards that drive business decision-making.

  • Use SQL and Python to query, clean, and analyze large datasets, ensuring accuracy and reliability of the data used in reporting.

  • Transform analytical findings into compelling narratives that connect data insights with business strategies for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Apply best practices in data visualization and user-centric design to deliver impactful, intuitive, and actionable dashboards and reports.

  • Collaborate with international teams as part of a global project, leveraging advanced English communication skills to ensure alignment, standardization, and knowledge sharing across regions.

  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality, actionable insights under tight deadlines with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.


What you’ll need:



  • BA/BS/MS in Math, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or other related quantitative field.

  • Advanced knowledge of Power BI (data modeling, DAX, report building, and dashboard design).

  • Advanced expertise in SQL for querying and data preparation.

  • Advanced English (spoken and written) to effectively communicate insights with international stakeholders.

  • Experience with Python for statistical analysis

  • Strong skills in data storytelling : ability to craft clear narratives that connect data insights to business strategy, ensuring stakeholders easily understand and act on the information.

  • Deep understanding of data visualization best practices, design principles, and user-centric dashboards.

  • Ability to translate complex datasets into insightful, visually compelling, and actionable reports.

  • Organized and detail-oriented, capable of delivering under tight timelines while ensuring quality.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills , able to tailor the message for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with strong collaboration skills to work across cross-functional teams.


More about you:



  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Storytelling mindset, connecting data insights to business impact in a compelling way.

  • Proactive and solution-oriented attitude, anticipating needs and suggesting improvements.

  • Collaborative approach, working effectively with cross-functional and international teams while building trust and alignment.

  • Detail-oriented, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and high-quality standards in all deliverables.

  • Adaptable and resilient, comfortable managing tight deadlines and shifting priorities.

  • Strategic thinking, always connecting insights to business outcomes and long-term goals.


What We Offer:



  • Performance based bonus*

  • Attendance Bonus*

  • Casual office and dress code

  • Days off*

  • Health, dental, and life insurance

  • Discounts on Ambev products*

  • School materials assurance

  • Language and training platforms


Equal Opportunity & Affinitive Action:


AB InBev Growth Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affinitive Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Senior Business Analyst - OSS
description:
As a proud subsidiary of NEC Corporation, Netcracker is a global software leader driving innovation at scale. We combine an open Agentic AI Platform with Cloud Native IT Solutions to help telecommunication providers transform, innovate, and deliver results that matter. Powered by cutting‑edge technology—and the passion of our people—we unlock new opportunities, spark innovation, and create better digital experiences for millions worldwide. Join us and be part of a team that is not just keeping up with the digital future—we’re leading it.

About the role

NetCracker Technology is seeking a Senior OSS Business Analyst with strong expertise in the OSS, particularly in Resource Inventory and Service Orchestration for different Telecom domains – IP/MPLS, DWDM, MW for B2B and B2C services as well as the Data Migration aspect of those. In this role, you will act as a customer‑facing expert, driving the identification of solution and product requirements throughout the analysis, design, implementation, training, migration, and testing phases of projects.

Role & Responsibilites

  • Identify, collect, clarify, and organize functional requirements for new solution features and change requests
  • Develop system use cases and information models for product, service, and resource management domains within OSS/BSS products
  • Design solution components, including object models, flows, user interfaces, and integration interfaces
  • Configure products to meet specific customer requirements and ensure proper solution delivery
  • Validate customer business needs and drive improvements in existing products and solutions
  • Capture and share best practices to support pre‑sales activities and solution positioning
  • Contribute across the delivery lifecycle, participating in analysis, design, prototyping, proof‑of‑concept, acceptance, and implementation projects
  • Perform gap analysis and define new user scenarios for out‑of‑the‑box (OOB) solutions in domains such as: Network planning, design, and build‑out, Network maintenance, upgrade, and decommissioning, Service design and activation, Network operations and maintenance
  • Conduct market and technology research in the telecommunications industry, learning standards in OSS/BSS, Network Automation and Orchestration
  • Participate in the development of new modules and components
  • Prepare data mapping and data validation documentation within the scope of ETL processes

Required Experience

  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills
  • Excellent skills in object‑oriented design (generalization, classification, decomposition, correlation, unification, decision tables)
  • University technical degree (maths, physics, IT, telecommunications, programming)
  • Experience in software product development and implementation (telecommunications domain preferred)
  • Understanding of network architecture and functionality of core/transport, access, and overlay/virtualization networks
  • Experience in OSS fulfillment and assurance processes for services and resources for one or several of the following: IP, Carrier Ethernet, SD‑WAN, GPON
  • Knowledge of UML or other object modeling notations and practical use of data modeling tools
  • Solid knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases
  • Understanding of OSS/BSS frameworks and telecom standards: TMF, ETSI, ITU, 3GPP, IETF, MEF, ONAP
  • Understanding of network management protocols and languages: YANG, REST, gRPC, gNMI, NETCONF, SNMP, CLI
  • Good knowledge of SQL
  • Experience using JSON for data exchange is a plus
  • Understanding of REST services is a plus
  • Understanding of software development lifecycles (RUP, Agile, etc)
  • Good technical English writing and communication skills
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in senior network engineering or analytical roles
  • Availability to work from the office on a Hybrid mode from either our São Paulo or Campinas offices

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Maths, Physics or related field

Connect With Us

Connect with us on LinkedIn and stay up to date on our company news.

title: Senior QA (Campinas Office), Brazil
description:
We are tech transformation specialists, uniting human expertise with AI to create scalable tech solutions.

With over 8,000 CI&Ters around the world, we’ve built partnerships with more than 1,000 clients during our 30 years of history. Artificial Intelligence is our reality.

Responsibilities:

  • Participate in developing and documenting User Stories by providing the test strategy and automation estimates.
  • Develop, document, and maintain the test strategy and test scenarios.
  • Build and execute unit, component, acceptance, integration, load, security, scalability, usability, and platform tests.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure consistency, quality, and reusability of test automation artifacts.
  • Partner with developers to ensure all areas of the application are fully tested and to find technical solutions for test automation.
  • Build and manage automated test suites and ensure execution through various environments, CI-CD pipelines, and to be used by NOC teams.
  • Regularly execute, maintain, and update automated test suites and analyze the results to identify the cause of failures.
  • Create defects for issues found with appropriate details and ensure issues are resolved, including validation of the fix and required automation updates.
  • Present appropriate results to sign off on software functionality for new production releases.
  • Work with cross-functional teams and release management to manage development, QA, and production releases of the software.
  • Perform exploratory testing to understand the feature and how it is implemented, to find additional or unexpected behavior, and to refine and define additional test cases for the feature.
  • Contribute to the QA automation framework using industry-standard tools and approaches.
  • Leverage and enhance coding standards and best practices for automated QA code.
  • Participate in analyzing Major Incidents and Emergency Change controls to identify opportunities to automate software quality test cases to reduce or eliminate those issues.

Qualifications:

  • Health and dental insurance
  • Meal and food allowance
  • Extended paternity leave
  • Partnership with gyms and health and wellness professionals via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass
  • Profit Sharing and Results Participation (PLR)
  • Life insurance
  • Continuous learning platform (CI&T University)
  • Discount club
  • Free online platform dedicated to physical, mental, and overall well-being
  • Pregnancy and responsible parenting course
  • Partnerships with online learning platforms
